heard: A cosmic signal reached Earth fainter than a lunar cell phone. In 2007, astrophysicist Duncan Lorimer discovered this weak whisper in archival data from 2001. The signal, a fast radio burst, traveled billions of light years from outside our galaxy. Although the blast lasted only a few milliseconds, its physical scale is truly staggering. In that single instant, it released more energy than our sun radiates in several days. Even Wilder, researchers recently detected repeating bursts that last just millionths of a second. Astronomers estimate that up to 10,000 of these titanic blasts occur every single day. They bombard our planet constantly, arriving almost completely silent.
